15: #include <iostream>
16: #include <sstream>
17: #include <string>
18: #include <algorithm>

22: #include "web/HttpServer.h"
23: #include "core/TextProcessor.h"
24: #include "core/InvertedIndex.h"
25: #include "core/SearchEngine.h"
26: #include "core/Trie.h"
27: #include "core/Similarity.h"
28: #include "core/StringMatch.h"
29: 
30: // 全局变量（简化实现）
31: InvertedIndex* g_index = nullptr;
32: SearchEngine* g_searchEngine = nullptr;
33: Trie* g_trie = nullptr;
34: Similarity* g_similarity = nullptr;
35: TextProcessor* g_processor = nullptr;
36: std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> g_bookContents;
37: std::vector<std::string> g_bookNames;
38: std::string g_dataDir = "data";
39: int g_nextDocId = 1;
40: 
41: // JSON 转义
42: std::string jsonEscape(const std::string& str) {
43:     std::string result;
44:     for (char c : str) {
45:         switch (c) {
46:             case '"': result += "\\\""; break;
47:             case '\\': result += "\\\\"; break;
48:             case '\n': result += "\\n"; break;
49:             case '\r': result += "\\r"; break;
50:             case '\t': result += "\\t"; break;
51:             default: result += c;
52:         }
53:     }
54:     return result;
55: }
56: 
57: std::string deriveBookName(const std::string& filename) {
58:     std::string name = filename;
59:     size_t lastSlash = name.find_last_of("/\\");
60:     if (lastSlash != std::string::npos) {
61:         name = name.substr(lastSlash + 1);
62:     }
63: 
64:     size_t dotPos = name.find_last_of('.');
65:     if (dotPos != std::string::npos) {
66:         name = name.substr(0, dotPos);
67:     }
68: 
69:     if (name.empty()) {
70:         name = "uploaded_text";
71:     }
72:     return name;
73: }
74: 
75: std::vector<std::string> splitTextLines(const std::string& text) {
76:     std::vector<std::string> lines;
77:     std::istringstream in(text);
78:     std::string line;
79: 
80:     while (std::getline(in, line)) {
81:         if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') {
82:             line.pop_back();
83:         }
84:         lines.push_back(line);
85:     }
86: 
87:     if (lines.empty() && !text.empty()) {
88:         lines.push_back(text);
89:     }
90: 
91:     return lines;
92: }

94: // 重建 Trie
95: void rebuildTrie() {
96:     delete g_trie;
97:     g_trie = new Trie();
98:     auto topTerms = g_index->getTopTerms(5000);
99:     for (const auto& term : topTerms) {
100:         g_trie->insert(term.first, term.second);
101:     }
102: }
103: 
104: void rebuildSearchComponents() {
105:     delete g_searchEngine;
106:     delete g_similarity;
107:     g_searchEngine = new SearchEngine(*g_index);
108:     g_similarity = new Similarity(*g_index);
109: }

111: int addBookToIndex(const std::string& bookName, const std::vector<std::string>& lines) {
112:     int docId = g_nextDocId++;
113:     g_index->addDocument(docId, bookName, lines);
114:     g_bookContents.push_back(lines);
115:     g_bookNames.push_back(bookName);
116: 
117:     rebuildTrie();
118:     rebuildSearchComponents();
119:     return docId;
120: }

122: // API: 加载文件
123: void handleLoad(const HttpRequest& req, HttpResponse& res) {
124:     std::string filename = req.params.count("file") ? req.params.at("file") : "";
125:     std::string bookName = req.params.count("name") ? req.params.at("name") : "";
126: 
127:     if (filename.empty()) {
128:         res.setJson("{\"error\": \"Missing parameter 'file'\"}");
129:         return;
130:     }
131: 
132:     // 构建完整路径
133:     std::string filePath = filename;
134:     if (filename[0] != '/' && filename.find('/') == std::string::npos) {
135:         filePath = g_dataDir + "/" + filename;
136:     }
137: 
138:     // 如果没有提供书名，使用文件名
139:     if (bookName.empty()) {
140:         bookName = deriveBookName(filename);
141:     }
142: 
143:     try {
144:         auto lines = g_processor->readLines(filePath);
145:         if (lines.empty()) {
146:             res.setJson("{\"error\": \"File is empty or cannot be read\"}");
147:             return;
148:         }
149: 
150:         int docId = addBookToIndex(bookName, lines);
151: 
152:         std::ostringstream json;
